The Abia State Police Command says a suspect who allegedly shot his brother dead in Amaiyi Mgbogho community, Isiala Ngwa North Local Government Area of the state, is in its custody, pending the conclusion of an investigation. The Police Public Relations Officer of the Abia State Command, DSP Maureen Chinaka, confirmed the incident on Wednesday. “Our attention was called to it, and we rapidly responded on Tuesday as officers from the Umuoba Police Division in Isiala Ngwa North Local Government Area of Abia State, in collaboration with community vigilantes, apprehended the suspect. Investigation is ongoing,” Chinaka said. Reports have it that the suspect, Iheanyi Nwosu, allegedly shot his biological brother, Eze Nwosu, a youth leader in Amaiyi Mgbogho community, with a short gun on Tuesday following a disagreement involving the suspect’s wife and the victim’s wife. Information has it that the late Eze Nwosu saw his wife running away from the family compound and tried to find out why she was fleeing when Iheanyi Nwosu suddenly emerged from his room with a short gun and shot his brother at close range in the neck, causing him to die instantly. However, the community’s local security outfit and other villagers combed the bushes and eventually apprehended the fleeing suspect at his hiding place. The suspect was handed over to the Umuoba Police Division for further investigation and prosecution. The community expressed deep sorrow over the incident, describing the victim as a peaceful member of the community.
